description: Figure 4 presents a line plot comparing the Macro-F1 scores for two tokenization methods—labeled “MATTER (ours)” in pink and “w/o material information” in purple—across varying numbers of tokens during training. The x-axis, labeled “Number of tokens,” ranges from 0.6 to 1.4 and is marked with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, ranges from 48 to 58 and is marked with tick labels at intervals of 2. The pink line, representing MATTER, begins at approximately 54%, rises to a peak of 58% at 1.0 tokens, then declines to about 52% at 1.4 tokens. The purple line, representing the method without material knowledge, starts near 52%, fluctuates slightly above 50%, and ends at approximately 48% at 1.4 tokens. Both lines exhibit some variability, but the pink line consistently remains above the purple line across the entire range of token counts shown.
